prōmoveō

prōmoveō, prōmovēre, prōmōvī, prōmōtum

verb, second conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

promote (to a post)

In this lexicon

  • promote

    also used · classical · Plin. Ep. 7.31.3: prōmōtus ad amplissimās prōcūrātiōnēs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 187: ad (in) ampliōrem gradum prōmovēre, promote to a higher rank; Traupman 31: ad superiōrem classem prōmovēre, to promote (a pupil) to the next class

Notes

  1. 1prōmoveō: short o in the present stem (Lewis & Short prōmōveō). The simple verb is mŏveō in Lewis & Short; the long ō belongs to the perfect mōvī and the participle mōtus, and the compound keeps the short vowel of the present.
